__comment__: Maex x LightWM ESSA task-family specs. One entry per task family. Each entry covers all instances of the family — instance-specific parameters (target receptacle, target id, etc.) are injected via subtask caller_mapping at call time, not duplicated per task.

land_on_receptacle.__comment__: Quadrotor takes off, flies to a target receptacle (possibly across rooms), and lands on it. No payload. Covers env0 task 0 (high kitchen table) and task 1 (dining table).

fields.agent_id: int (graph node id of the agent)
fields.target_receptacle_id: int (graph node id of the target receptacle, e.g. 35)
fields.agent_flight_state: string ('LAND'|'FLYING'); read from observation 'Now my state is: ...'
fields.agent_current_room_id: int|null (current room id, parsed from 'I am INSIDE the <room>(<id>)' or 'Now I am in the <room>(<id>)')
fields.agent_position: string|null (e.g. 'on <childroom floor>(3)' or 'above <high kitchen table>(35)'; canonical text of the agent's primary spatial edge)
fields.agent_above_target: bool (true iff observation contains 'I am ABOVE the <target_receptacle>(<target_receptacle_id>)')

init_rules: goal: MUST be a concise normalized string (e.g., 'the quadrotor(22) lands on the high kitchen table(35)').
agent_class / agent_id: parse from goal_instruction. The unique <class>(<id>) token that appears as the SUBJECT of 'lands on' is the actor.
target_receptacle / target_receptacle_id: parse the <class>(<id>) token that appears as the OBJECT of 'lands on' in goal_instruction.
agent_flight_state: read from INITIAL_OBSERVATION substring 'Now my state is: <X>.' — at episode start, expected value is 'LAND'.
agent_current_room_id: read the id from INITIAL_OBSERVATION substring 'I am INSIDE the <room_class>(<room_id>).'.

agent_position: produce the canonical string from INITIAL_OBSERVATION. Prefer 'I am ON the <X>(<id>)' (then write 'on <X>(<id>)'). If only 'I am INSIDE the <room>(<id>)' is present (no ON edge), write 'inside <room>(<id>)'.
agent_above_target: MUST be false at init.
landed_on_target: MUST be false at init.
